digest.component_or_area: plan-review verdict dispatcher and criteria assembly
propositions: A malformed criteria configuration at the assemble-criteria step raises CriteriaError but is recorded as an undifferentiated failed-step string, losing typed identity.

The generic workflow interpreter's source-blind degraded tail classifies every unrecovered assemble failure as an LLM outage and unconditionally stamps llm_unavailable=true, violating the LLM-failure scope contract.

The plan-review verdict must distinguish structured criteria/config failures from genuine LLM unavailability and route them to a dedicated config-fault path with fail-closed INDETERMINATE and actionable diagnostics.
Deterministic findings and coverage must survive the config-fault verdict path unchanged; deterministic blockers must remain BLOCK rather than being masked by config-fault INDETERMINATE.
The structured failure kind and config-fault diagnostic must be carried from criteria assembly through to the output contract without string-based classification.
